title: Multi-terminal Josephson junctions as topological materials
venue: arXiv; later published in Nature Communications
abstract: This foundational proposal treats superconducting phases as synthetic crystal momenta and predicts Weyl singularities in multiterminal junctions. It is a strong starting point for understanding the modern topology program in these devices.

title: Topological transconductance quantization in a four-terminal Josephson junction
venue: arXiv; later published in Physical Review B
abstract: This work connects the theoretical Weyl-junction proposal to a measurable transport signature. It studies when nonlocal transconductance remains quantized despite nonadiabatic transitions and relaxation.

title: Multi-terminal Josephson junctions: a road to topological flux networks
venue: arXiv perspective; later published in Europhysics Letters
abstract: This perspective traces multiterminal Josephson topology back to topological flux networks and early quantum Hall ideas. It offers historical context and a compact overview of the field's theoretical and experimental development.
